description: This Python script converts a JSON input file into C header and optionally C source files containing definitions and dumps of the JSON structure. It enables automatic generation of C code from JSON schemas or data.

methods.name: process_cmd_line()
methods.description: Parses command line arguments for input/output files, processing options, and keys.

methods.name: json_load(filename)
methods.description: Loads JSON data from a specified file.

methods.name: json_to_header_body(json_in, fh, prefix="", level=0, max_level=0, valid_keys=None)
methods.description: Recursively processes JSON data to generate C macro definitions based on data types.

methods.name: json_to_header_body_dump(json_in, fh, fc, prefix="", level=0, max_level=0, dump_keys=None)
methods.description: Generates dump strings for JSON objects that are included in specified dump keys.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main driver function that orchestrates reading input, processing, and writing output files.

ctags.name: json_to_header_body
ctags.pattern: /^def json_to_header_body(json_in, fh, prefix="", level=0, max_level=0, valid_keys=None):$/

ctags.name: json_to_header_body_dump
ctags.pattern: /^def json_to_header_body_dump(json_in, fh, fc, prefix="", level=0, max_level=0, dump_keys=None):$/
ctags.signature: (json_in, fh, fc, prefix="", level=0, max_level=0, dump_keys=None)
